test("[QUOTA_RESERVED] (primary) ReserveSubscriptionQuota -> emit SubscriptionQuotaReserved", () => {
  const initialState: FundQuotaState = {"minPurchase":"0.00","maxSingleLimit":"0.00","fundTotalUsed":"0.00","fundTotalCap":"0.00","perAccountCap":"0.00","accountUsed":{"id_2":"0.00"}};
  const cmd: ReserveSubscriptionQuotaCommand = {"type":"ReserveSubscriptionQuota","accountId":"id_2","amount":"0.00"};
  const outcome = handleFundQuotaCommand(initialState, cmd);
  assert.equal(outcome.ok, true, "expected command acceptance");
  if (outcome.ok) {
    assert.deepEqual(outcome.events.map(e => e.type), ["SubscriptionQuotaReserved"]);
    const nextState = replayFundQuota(initialState, outcome.events);
    const axiomResult = checkFundQuotaAxioms(nextState);
    assert.equal(axiomResult.ok, true, `axiom violation: ${axiomResult.violated.join(", ")}`);
    assert.deepEqual(nextState.fundTotalUsed, "0.00");
    assert.deepEqual(nextState.accountUsed["id_2"], "0.00");
  }
});
